reasoning: 1. TARGET ENGAGEMENT: No biomarker data available to confirm aducanumab engaged amyloid beta plaques. The trial lacks PD/PK data or target engagement biomarkers. 2. PATHWAY MODULATION: No pathway biomarkers reported to assess whether amyloid clearance occurred or downstream neurodegeneration pathways were modulated. 3. CLINICAL TRANSLATION: Mixed results - the high dose arm showed significant improvement on the primary endpoint CDR-SB (p=0.012, effect size -0.39) and multiple secondary endpoints (MMSE p=0.0493, ADAS-Cog 13 p=0.0097, ADCS-ADL-MCI p=0.0006), while the low dose arm failed on all endpoints. This suggests a dose-response relationship. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: No subgroup analyses reported. The early Alzheimer's population appears appropriate for the amyloid hypothesis. 5. CONFOUNDERS: Study was discontinued for futility, not safety. The dose-response pattern (high dose succeeding where low dose failed) suggests the mechanism may work but requires adequate dosing.
